profiles.label: Microsoft Excel
profiles.description: A workbook with a Data sheet (numbers stored as numbers, real dates, one header row, frozen header, filters), a Report sheet describing the sources, rules and steps, and a Log sheet with the audit log.

profiles.label: Databases, Python, R, BI tools (CSV)
profiles.description: UTF-8 CSV without a byte-order mark: comma-separated, ISO dates, "." as decimal separator, header "Name [unit]".

profiles.label: Python, Spark, DuckDB, data lakes (Parquet)
profiles.description: Apache Parquet with one typed column per field: numbers as doubles, whole numbers as 64-bit integers, dates as dates, date-times as UTC timestamps; column names "Name [unit]".

profiles.label: QGIS / ArcGIS / web maps (GeoJSON)
profiles.description: An RFC 7946 GeoJSON FeatureCollection in WGS84 longitude/latitude, built from the geometry column or the latitude and longitude columns.
